# Flow Steward Documentation Index

Use this file to discover the public documentation pages before asking a
documentation assistant to answer from Flow Steward docs.

## Start Here

- [Start Here](docs/intro): Product introduction, role router, and documentation map.
- [Product Tour](docs/user/product-tour): Main screens and navigation.
- [Use Cases](docs/user/use-cases): Common user scenarios.
- [Getting Started](docs/user/getting-started): Shortest path to a first run.
- [Core Concepts](docs/user/core-concepts): Main product objects.
- [Feature Catalog](docs/user/feature-catalog): User-facing capability map.

## User Guide

- [Dashboard](docs/user/dashboard): First-screen activity, attention, cost, failure, and recent-work signals.

- [Project Knowledge](docs/user/project-knowledge-and-code-intelligence): Internal project context and the removed public KB/code-indexing boundary.

- [Workflow and Extension Catalogs](docs/user/workflow-and-extension-catalogs): Browse ready-made automation, install and update extensions, and contribute releases.
- [First Workflow](docs/user/first-workflow): First controlled workflow run.
- [Workflow Export and Import](docs/user/workflow-promotion): Copy workflows between environments using YAML export, dependency checks, and import.
- [Failed-Run Diagnostics](docs/user/failed-run-diagnostics): Inspect and recover failed jobs.
- [Jobs And Approvals](docs/user/jobs-and-approvals): Runtime evidence and human gates.
- [Agents And Skills](docs/user/agents-and-skills): Agent and skill concepts.
- [Tools And MCP](docs/user/tools-and-mcp): External MCP catalogs and tools.
- [Datasets And Data Connections](docs/user/datasets-and-data-connections): Scoped data access.
- [Extensions](docs/user/extensions): Extension operation.
- [Registry Management](docs/user/registry-management): Registry object management.
- [Trash And Lifecycle](docs/user/trash-and-lifecycle): Soft delete, restore, and hard-delete planning.

## Deploy & Run

- [Installation](docs/deploy/installation): Choose a Docker-host or managed-platform route.
- [Answer the Installer Questions](docs/deploy/installer-walkthrough): Every prompt, Docker prerequisites, and Apache/Nginx/Traefik value discovery.
- [Render (Compact)](docs/deploy/render): Install with the public Render Blueprint and operate the deployed runtime.
- [Elestio (Compact)](docs/deploy/elestio): Install the Compact Compose template on a dedicated provider VM.
- [Platform Deployment](docs/deploy/platforms): Railway, Fly.io, Render, and DigitalOcean Droplet requirements and support boundaries.
- [Diagnostics And Migration](docs/deploy/diagnostics-and-migration): Doctor, targeted repairs, and Clone transfer between servers.

- [Installation And Updates](docs/user/installation-and-updates): Installer, update, status, and doctor flows.
- [Installer Reference](docs/reference/installer): `install.sh` commands and flags.
- [Upgrade Reference](docs/reference/upgrade): Upgrade flow and checks.
- [Deployment Checklist](docs/deploy/deployment-checklist): Production-readiness preflight.
- [Environment Variables](docs/reference/environment-variables): Environment variable catalog.
- [Configuration](docs/reference/configuration): Configuration files and backend profiles.
- [Backups And Restore](docs/deploy/backups-and-restore): Database backup, validation, restore, and drills.
- [Storage And Artifacts](docs/deploy/storage-and-artifacts): Logs, artifacts, backups, extensions, workspaces, and object storage.
- [Observability](docs/deploy/observability): Sentry, Prometheus, readiness, metrics, and incident evidence.
- [Deployment Troubleshooting](docs/deploy/troubleshooting): Problem-shaped operator checks.
- [Rollback Runbook](docs/deploy/rollback): Rollback boundaries and database restore flow.
- [Deployment Architecture](docs/deploy/architecture): Operator-oriented runtime component map.

## Integrations & Extensions

- [Flow Steward Agent Plugin](docs/integrations/agent-plugin): One plugin for user workflow/operations and developer extension skills; install, verify and update with an existing MCP connection.
- [Extension Authoring Skill](docs/integrations/extension-authoring-skill): Developer task guide and optional individual canonical skill download.

- [Incoming Workflow Webhooks](docs/integrations/incoming-workflow-webhooks): Receive external events and start workflows.
- [External MCP Catalogs](docs/integrations/external-mcp-catalogs): Register external MCP servers as tool catalogs.
- [Connect An AI Client With MCP](docs/integrations/built-in-mcp-quick-start): Built-in Flow Steward MCP quick start.
- [Start And Observe A Workflow Run With The Public API](docs/integrations/public-api-quick-start): Explicit workflow launch and job observation.
- [Extension Operator Guide](docs/integrations/extension-operator-guide): Install, preview, enable, health-check, and disable extensions.
- [Build An Extension](docs/integrations/build-an-extension): Extension manifest, runtime, testing, and packaging path.
- [Integrations](docs/developer/integrations): Developer integration choices.
- [Developer Extensions](docs/developer/extensions): Extension bundle development.
